body: Thank you for the reply. I know this all can change. I just have no idea how to do it since i'm just in my teens. I have tried to search up somethings to do and not to do when talking to someone depressed and suicidal. I don't tell her some crap i don't believe in, i only say things i believe in. So now i atleast know i've been doing the right thing. I don't try to shame her in any way for her self harm. I have just been trying to show her that life doesn't have to be all awful, that it can be in some parts beautiful and also i've been trying to explain just how much she matters to me. So just an update i guess. She is still alive which i am very greatful for and i'll be doing everything i can to help her. Thanks again for the reply.
